Type.evidence_source: The interview was a combination of a narrative part and follow-up questions. The interviews were conducted by three researchers/clinicians with extensive knowledge in the field of suicidology and in qualitative interviewing of suicide bereaved individuals. All interviews, lasting an average of 2.5 hr (range 1.5to 3 hr), were audio recorded and transcribed verbatim.

Area.evidence_source: What are your thoughts on the circumstances that led to the suicide of ...? Topics covered by Shneidman included details of the death, personal and family history of the deceased, personality and lifestyle, emotional patterns, interpersonal issues, any significant changes in the deceased's life in the years preceding death, substance use, and their strengths and successes.
